2.16.11
Textbox.Left
The Textbox.Left element specifies the distance of a Textbox from the left of the text box's
container, such as a Rectangle or Body. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value
MUST be an RdlSize.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.Left element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
